data.text/markdown:
Selfie-stick curation bench

Every frame carries three instruments: the LAION aesthetic (taste), the depth layers (geometry — does the frame have near/mid/far, or is the camera against a wall), and the VLM judge (a rubric reading of "does this feel like you're in the scene"). None of them is the verdict; your eye is. This bench lets you move the thresholds and watch who survives. Run it with marimo run curation_notebook.py (or marimo edit to change it) from the omen-perception venv.
